name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: DSH Studio Desktop Application - Standalone Electron Host for DeepSeek Harness Studio
author: DeepSeek AI & Community

scripts.check:bundle-integrity: node -e "const {readdirSync,existsSync}=require('fs'),{join}=require('path');function check(d,depth=0){if(!existsSync(d))return;for(const e of readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(e.isDirectory()){const f=join(d,e.name);if(e.name==='node_modules'&&depth>0){console.error('FAIL: Nested node_modules found at',f);process.exit(1)}else check(f,depth+1)}}}check('bundled-server/node_modules');console.log('✅ Bundle integrity passed: No nested node_modules found.');"
